name: veylcore-ui
description: Build workspace for VeylCore NUI apps. Compiled output is committed into each resource's web/dist.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @veyl/lib-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/target-ui && npm run build -w @veyl/inventory-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @veyl/lib-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/target-ui && npm run typecheck -w @veyl/inventory-ui
